name: recommendation-letter
description: Generate support, recommendation, appreciation, acceptance, and dispense (short-stay invitation) letters for a supervisor's students and candidates, in LaTeX compiled to PDF, signed by the active profile's author. Ingests the candidate's own files (CV, transcript, project description, motivation letter) and highlights both the candidate's dossier and the professor's own experience with the candidate. Trigger on: recommendation letter, support letter, appreciation letter, acceptance letter, invitation letter, dispense / work permit exemption letter, lettre d'appui, lettre de recommandation, lettre d'appreciation, lettre d'acceptation, lettre d'invitation, lettre de dispense, PFLA, ELAP, CRSNG, FRQNT, MITACS, or /recommendation-letter.
